cutover_order: 1. Owner provides Shared Drive access to the company service account path (see the runbook owner action).
2. Create the 40_Content article folders for the three review docs through the governed folder operation, with fixed idempotency keys.
3. Copy the three review docs and their three source packages; compare names, MIME types and SHA-256 against this manifest.
4. Replay the copy; confirm zero new files.

5. Export the n8n Data Tables from Cloud (Raw_Media, Content_Cases, Photo_Content_Queue, Publication_Radar, Publication_Analysis, Website_Content, Website_Content_Sync, LinkedIn_Drafts) and import to self-hosted.
6. Rebuild one workflow at a time on self-hosted inactive, run a manual canary against a test folder, then switch the single trigger.
7. Pause the Cloud twin only after the self-hosted canary passes and the rollback step below is written down.
rollback: Originals are never touched, so rollback is: reactivate the Cloud twin (kept paused, not deleted) and delete only the corporate copies created under the recorded idempotency keys.
